column12: Así es: that's right. Así que: so.
¿Verdad? at the end of a sentence asks for agreement.
¿Te parece bien?: is that OK with you?

column5: to feel; to be sorry (lo siento)
column12: Lo siento: I'm sorry. Feeling well or ill is sentirse: me siento mal.
¡Oye!: Hey! (to get a friend's attention). ¡Oiga! to a stranger.
